sections.heading: How we evaluate
sections.body: SoftwareGlimpse evaluates AI software on ease of use, fit to the primary AI job, output usefulness, workflow depth, connectors, governance/privacy, scalability, value, and model/capability depth. Affiliate relationships never influence scores. LLM assistants, writing tools, voice, presentations, website builders, ad creative, agent builders, and workflow automation platforms are ranked within job clusters — never forced into a single undifferentiated ranking.

sections.heading: Evidence limitations
sections.body: This draft may rely on fixture research. It is not indexable and does not claim hands-on testing or verified live pricing.
